P R O F E S S I O N A L S U M M A R Y

Results-driven Data Governance Officer and Certified SAFe Scrum Master with nearly 8 years of experience in data governance, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement. Proven track record in implementing GDPR-aligned data governance frameworks, authoring data policies, managing compliance documentation, and enforcing data quality standards within banking and financial services environments. Adept at collaborating with data stewards, IT teams, and business units to ensure consistent data governance practices. Skilled in requirements analysis, metadata documentation, data lineage mapping, and delivering governance dashboards using Power BI. Experienced in Agile delivery, backlog management, and driving data-driven decision-making in fast-paced, regulated industries.

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E
Business Analyst | Société Générale
2024 – Present
Banking Domain | GDPR Compliance | Data Governance Platform

Delivered governance requirements for a core enterprise data platform underpinning GDPR compliance across the Banking division, ensuring full alignment with data privacy, security, and Group Data Policy standards.

Authored and maintained data governance documentation including data flow maps, data classification standards, and compliance audit trails — supporting 100% adherence to regulatory requirements. • Mapped end-to-end data lineage for key datasets, documenting data origin, transformation logic, and downstream consumption to support regulatory traceability and metadata governance.

Collaborated with data stewards, product owners, and IT teams to define and enforce data quality standards, resolving data inconsistencies and driving continuous improvement across datasets. • Facilitated requirements gathering and translated business data governance needs into functional specifications, user stories, and process workflows for engineering execution.
Led stakeholder engagement across business units, ensuring consistent adoption of data governance policies and practices in alignment with GDPR Article 30 obligations.
Defined and tracked data governance KPIs, delivering regular reporting and risk assessments to senior leadership to support informed data strategy decisions.
Drove agile delivery as SAFe-certified Scrum Master, managing product backlog, resolving cross-team dependencies, and enabling iterative delivery of governance platform features.
Collaborated with QA teams to define test strategies, execute UAT, and validate system functionality against compliance and governance requirements.
Senior Business Analyst – Data & Campaign Governance | Epsilon
MarTech | Retail, Sports & Pharma | Global Client On boarding | Data Quality

Governed audience data quality across Retail, Sports, and Pharmaceutical client portfolios — designing and enforcing validation rules, consistency checks, and QA governance processes to ensure data integrity.
Designed and maintained metadata documentation and data dictionaries for audience segmentation datasets, supporting data lineage and governance transparency across campaigns.
Headed global client on boarding onto Epsilon's Messaging platform across NA, APAC, and EMEA, achieving 100% process accuracy by enforcing data standards and governance controls at ingestion.
Built dynamic Power BI dashboards from scratch for operational and data governance reporting, enabling real-time visibility into data quality KPIs and campaign performance metrics.
Collaborated cross-functionally with Product, Solutions Architecture, Client Services, and Loyalty teams to define data policies and ensure consistent governance across platform enhancements.
Led product testing and feedback cycles for a new ESP in-house tool — overseeing data validation testing, bug tracking, and use case documentation to improve data usability.
Authored SOWs, process improvement plans, and compliance documentation to support regulatory and audit readiness, maintaining full data management standards adherence.
Mentored and on boarded junior Business Analysts, building team capability in data governance practices, documentation standards, and client data management.
Assistant Systems Engineer | Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
IT Services | Systems Engineering Foundation
Contributed to systems engineering and data operations projects, building foundational skills in structured data handling, documentation, and process compliance.
